name: something that is breathing
description: Something here is alive in the way a sleeping animal is alive, and once you have noticed you will not stop noticing.
looks: In. Out. Slowly, in time with something that is not you.
Warm, and slightly giving, the way skin over a rib is giving.
It slows while you watch it, and everything gets very fond.
says: Breathe with me. You already are.
I was doing this before you came in.
Do not be alarmed. I would not know how.
